    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_metadata
      message: "All three metadata lookups resolved successfully"
    output: audit_result

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "metadata_resolved"

  - id: step_flag_manual_assignment
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_author
      mapping:
        status: "manual_author_assignment_required"
        reason: "author_not_found"
    output: manual_assignment_payload

  - id: step_notify_manual_assignment
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: manual_assignment_payload
      recipient: "cms_admin"
      message: "Author not found for article. Manual assignment required."
    output: notify_result

  - id: step_log_manual_flag
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: manual_assignment_payload
      message: "Article flagged for manual author assignment"
    output: audit_flag_result

  - id: step_terminate_manual
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "flagged_manual_author_assignment"

workflow_id: ticket_producer_assignment
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_manager
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "manager"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_assignment_request
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/tickets/assignment-request"
    output: raw_assignment_request

  - id: step_validate_request_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_assignment_request
      schema: assignment_request_schema
    output: validated_request

  - id: step_extract_ticket_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_request
      field: "ticket_id"
    output: ticket_id

  - id: step_extract_producer_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_request
      field: "producer_id"
    output: producer_id

  - id: step_read_ticket
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: "tickets"
      filter:
        id: ticket_id
    output: raw_ticket_record

  - id: step_validate_ticket_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_ticket_record
      schema: ticket_record_schema
    output: validated_ticket

  - id: step_check_unassigned
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "validated_ticket.assigned_to IS NULL"
      input: validated_ticket
    output: unassigned_check

  - id: step_route_if_already_assigned
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "unassigned_check == false"
      target: step_terminate_already_assigned

  - id: step_read_producer
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: "producers"
      filter:
        id: producer_id
    output: raw_producer_record

  - id: step_validate_producer_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_producer_record
      schema: producer_record_schema
    output: validated_producer

  - id: step_check_producer_active
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "validated_producer.status == 'active'"
      input: validated_producer
    output: active_check

  - id: step_route_if_inactive
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "active_check == false"
      target: step_terminate_producer_inactive

  - id: step_build_ticket_update
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_request
      mapping:
        assigned_to: "producer_id"
        status: "pendiente"
    output: ticket_update_payload

  - id: step_update_ticket
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: ticket_update_payload
      table: "tickets"
      operation: "update"
      filter:
        id: ticket_id
    output: update_result

  - id: step_build_history_entry
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_request
      mapping:
        ticket_id: "ticket_id"
        changed_by: "auth_result.user_id"
        old_status: "a confirmar"
        new_status: "pendiente"
        assigned_to: "producer_id"
        change_type: "assignment"
    output: history_entry

  - id: step_write_ticket_history
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: history_entry
      table: "ticket_history"
      operation: "insert"
    output: history_write_result

  - id: step_log_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: history_entry
      action: "ticket_assigned"
      details: "Ticket assigned to producer via manager dashboard"
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: step_build_notification
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_request
      mapping:
        recipient_id: "producer_id"
        message: "A new ticket has been assigned to you."
        ticket_id: "ticket_id"
    output: notification_payload

  - id: step_notify_producer
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: notification_payload
      channel: "dashboard"
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Ticket successfully assigned to producer."

  - id: step_terminate_already_assigned
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      message: "Ticket is already assigned and cannot be reassigned via this workflow."

  - id: step_terminate_producer_inactive
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      message: "Selected producer is not active."

workflow_id: pdf_text_extraction_and_structure_detection
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "authenticated_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/client/pdf/selected_file"
      description: "Receive the PDF file selected by the user in the browser"
    output: raw_pdf_data

  - id: step_validate_pdf
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_data
      schema: pdf_file_schema
      rules:
        - "must_have_text_layer"
        - "valid_pdf_binary"
    output: validated_pdf

  - id: step_iterate_pages
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf
      iterator: page
      description: "Load the PDF and iterate over each page"
    output: pdf_pages

  - id: step_extract_text_items
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: pdf_pages
      field: "text_items_with_font_size"
      description: "Extract all text items along with their font size metadata from each page"
    output: raw_text_items

  - id: step_validate_text_items
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_text_items
      schema: text_items_schema
      rules:
        - "each_item_has_text_content"
        - "each_item_has_font_size_number"
    output: validated_text_items

  - id: step_compute_median_font_size
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      group_by: "all"
      operation: "median"
      field: "font_size"
      description: "Compute the median font size to establish the body text baseline"
    output: median_font_stats

  - id: step_merge_text_with_median
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      secondary: median_font_stats
      key: "global"
      description: "Attach median font size to each text item for comparison"
    output: text_items_with_baseline

  - id: step_apply_heading_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: text_items_with_baseline
      rule: "font_size_ratio_comparison"
      condition: "item.font_size > median_font_size * 1.2"
      classify_as: "heading"
      default_class: "body_text"
      description: "Classify text items with font size significantly above the median as headings using font-size ratio"
    output: classified_text_items

  - id: step_transform_structured_output
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: classified_text_items
      mapping:
        headings: "items where classification == heading"
        body: "items where classification == body_text"
        structure: "hierarchical_document_tree"
      description: "Reshape classified items into structured document with headings and body text"
    output: structured_document

  - id: step_format_result
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: structured_document
      format: "json"
      locale: "fr-FR"
      description: "Serialize the structured document for the French-language academic PDF reader"
    output: formatted_result

  - id: step_log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      action: "pdf_text_extraction_completed"
      details: "Client-side PDF text extraction and heading structure detection finished"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: formatted_result
      message: "Extraction du texte et détection de la structure terminées avec succès."
      channel: "browser_ui"
    output: notification_result
dsl_type_errors: Step 'step_transform_structured_output': op 'transform_json' requires input of type 'records' but 'classified_text_items' has type 'boolean'. Make sure the step producing 'classified_text_items' uses an op that outputs a list of records (e.g. fetch_api, filter_records, validate_schema, read_database).

    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_upload
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/attachments/upload"
    output: raw_upload

  - id: step_validate_upload_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_upload
      schema: attachment_upload_schema
    output: validated_upload

  - id: step_extract_request_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "parent_request_id"
    output: parent_request_id

  - id: step_verify_parent_request
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: requests
      filter:
        id: parent_request_id
    output: raw_parent_request

  - id: step_validate_parent_request
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_parent_request
      schema: existing_request_schema
    output: validated_parent_request

  - id: step_check_parent_exists
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "parent_request_exists"
      input_value: validated_parent_request
    output: parent_exists_result

  - id: step_route_no_parent
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "parent_exists_result == false"
      target: step_terminate_no_parent

  - id: step_extract_file_metadata
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "file_metadata"
    output: file_metadata

  - id: step_validate_file_type_size
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "validate_file_type_and_size"
      input_value: file_metadata
    output: file_validation_result

  - id: step_route_invalid_file
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "file_validation_result.valid == false"
      target: step_terminate_invalid_file

    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "file_content"
    output: file_content

  - id: step_encrypt_file
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: file_content
      field: "data"
    output: encrypted_file

  - id: step_store_attachment
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: encrypted_file
      url: "/storage/attachments/store"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_storage_result

  - id: step_validate_storage_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_storage_result
      schema: storage_result_schema
    output: validated_storage_result

    params:

        file_type: "file_metadata.type"
        file_size: "file_metadata.size"
    output: attachment_record

    params:

workflow_id: client_record_upsert
steps:
  - id: step_extract_client_identifier
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: incoming_message
      field: "client_identifier"
    output: raw_client_identifier

  - id: step_validate_identifier
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_client_identifier
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - identifier
        properties:
          identifier:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
    output: validated_identifier

  - id: step_apply_dedup_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "if channel == 'whatsapp' then dedup_key = 'name'; if channel == 'email' then dedup_key = 'email'"
      input: validated_identifier
    output: dedup_config

  - id: step_authenticate_system
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "system_service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_lookup_existing_client
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: clients
      query_field: dedup_config
    output: raw_existing_client

  - id: step_sanitize_existing_client
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_existing_client
      mapping:
        client_id: "$.id"
        client_name: "$.name"
        client_email: "$.email"
        found: "$.found"
    output: existing_client

  - id: step_route_upsert
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "existing_client.found == true"
      true_step: step_extract_client_id
      false_step: step_create_client_record

  - id: step_create_client_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: validated_identifier
      table: clients
      operation: insert
    output: created_client

  - id: step_handle_write_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: step_create_client_record
      on_error: step_retry_create

  - id: step_retry_create
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: step_create_client_record
      max_retries: 3

  - id: step_merge_client_result
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      left: existing_client
      right: created_client
      key: "client_id"
      strategy: "coalesce"
    output: final_client_record

  - id: step_extract_client_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: final_client_record
      field: "client_id"
    output: client_id

  - id: step_log_upsert
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: client_id
      action: "client_record_upsert"
      detail: "Client record upserted successfully"

workflow_id: pdf_article_extraction_via_ai_vision
steps:
  - id: authenticate_drive_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "drive_service_account"
    output: auth_result

  - id: search_pending_pdfs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_pdf_list

  - id: validate_pdf_list
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_list
      schema: pdf_file_list_schema
    output: validated_pdf_list

  - id: loop_pdf_files
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf_list
      step: download_pdf_binary
    output: loop_context

  - id: download_pdf_binary
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/download"
      file_id_from: validated_pdf_list
    output: raw_pdf_binary

  - id: filter_valid_pdfs
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_binary
      condition: "binary_content IS NOT NULL AND size > 0"
    output: valid_pdf_binary

  - id: send_to_ai_vision
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: valid_pdf_binary
      url: "/api/ai-vision/extract"
      method: "POST"
      body:
        prompt: "Extract structured article content from this PDF. Return JSON with fields: title, author, section, lead, body, highlighted_quotes, sidebars. If the document contains multiple book reviews, set es_multiple to true and return an array of articles."
        pdf_binary_ref: valid_pdf_binary
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: transform_ai_response
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      mapping:
        strip_markdown_fences: true
        replace_double_quotes_in_content: "replace('\"', \"'\")"
        ensure_lead_not_empty: "coalesce(lead, first_sentence_of_body)"
    output: parsed_article_data

  - id: validate_required_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: parsed_article_data
      schema:
        required_fields:
          - title
          - section
          - content
        conditional:
          - when: "es_multiple == true"
            required_fields:
              - articles
              - articles[].title
              - articles[].section
              - articles[].content
        rules:
          - field: lead
            condition: "NOT_EMPTY"
    output: validated_article_data

  - id: check_multiple_format
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "es_multiple == true"
      input_ref: validated_article_data
    output: format_decision

  - id: route_by_format
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "format_decision == true"
      true_step: handle_multiple_reviews
      false_step: handle_single_article

  - id: handle_multiple_reviews
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_article_data
      collection_field: "articles"
      step: write_article_record
    output: multiple_write_results

  - id: handle_single_article
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_article_data
      format: "json"
      template:
        title: "$.title"
        author: "$.author"
        section: "$.section"
        lead: "$.lead"
        body: "$.body"
        highlighted_quotes: "$.highlighted_quotes"
        sidebars: "$.sidebars"
    output: formatted_single_article

  - id: write_article_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: validated_article_data
      table: "extracted_articles"
    output: write_result

  - id: log_extraction_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_article_data
      action: "pdf_article_extracted"
      details:
        source: "google_drive_pending_articles"
        ai_model: "vision_extraction"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: notify_editor
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: validated_article_data
      recipient: "editor@economicsmagazine.com"
      message: "New article(s) extracted from PDF and stored in database."
      channel: "email"
    output: notification_result

  - id: handle_extraction_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error_in:
        - send_to_ai_vision
        - transform_ai_response
        - validate_required_fields
      route_to: retry_ai_extraction

  - id: retry_ai_extraction
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: send_to_ai_vision
      max_retries: 3
      backoff_seconds: 10
    output: retry_result

  - id: terminate_on_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "PDF article extraction workflow finished successfully."
